title: Raises
statement: Implement `solve(text)`. A blank string after strip returns `error`. Any other string returns `ok`. This is the parser a test would wrap with assertRaises on the blank input. The sandbox uses the string instead of an exception.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: assertRaises passes only when the call inside the block raises.

editorial: assertRaises passes only when the call inside the block raises. A blank string is the input that should fail. Returning a distinct error string lets the judge see the rejection without depending on the harness to expect an exception.
